protocol_history: Initial protocol committed in f78b8eb; canonical target universe corrected in 48fda5a before formal fitting.
Structured batching clarified in 266c3ae; per-batch optimizer update fixed in 24cd68a.
Solver iteration limit and tolerance amended in 4b48a6d after the first full execution failed its convergence check.
Biliary outer-fold performance was inspected during debugging; a diagnostic absolute-target variant was also inspected, but the final run retained the original residual target.

Therefore the protocol status frozen_before_model_implementation_and_result_access does not describe the entire development history. Treat this as a development benchmark, not untouched prospective confirmation.

numerical_audit.elastic_net: All 456 recorded paths met relative coefficient-change stopping rules, not a dual-gap or per-target KKT certificate. Small synthetic agreement with sklearn does not establish full-data optimization accuracy.
numerical_audit.restart_implementation: The current restart expression cancels the momentum update whenever the coefficient step is nonzero and momentum exceeds one. It behaves as an unaccelerated proximal solver; do not claim effective FISTA acceleration. The objective is unchanged.
numerical_audit.missing_labels: Elastic Net fits observation-mask groups with separate intercept centering; reduced-rank ridge imputes centered training residuals by zero.
numerical_audit.selection: PCR, RRR and shared-alpha Elastic Net use inner NDCG; DeepDEP uses first inner fold MSE for epoch selection. Tuning budgets and optimization targets are not identical.

deepdep_reproduction_boundary: Same-data adaptation, not exact published Exp-DeepDEP reproduction.
DepMap processed four-modality intersection supplies 4678 of 6016 expression features; 1338 positions use official CCLE reference means. These are not all unavailable in the raw expression release.
New Chronos release, residual targets, whole-lineage holdout, structured cell-by-all-target batches, and non-KIRC-only pretraining differ from the original model.
Poor adaptation performance cannot establish inferiority of the original DeepDEP publication.

tcga_pretraining_correction.actual_behavior: Full numerical source rows were parsed before selecting non-KIRC columns. No excluded KIRC values entered training matrices, normalization statistics, model selection or new outcome evaluation. KIRC matrix header supplied exclusion IDs; file hashing also read bytes.

external_scope: Primary shared-alpha Elastic Net, PCR, RRR, adapted DeepDEP and prior; secondary targetwise-MSE Elastic Net not externally refitted. The Sanger cohort was previously inspected and is not a new Locked Test.
interpretation: No complex method meets the internal positive-95%-interval primary-NDCG superiority gate. A secondary Spearman gain alone cannot change that prespecified conclusion.
